snippet.title: Little Nightmares VR: Altered Echoes - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Music to the ears, a dark behind the eyes. Everything you thought was out there… is now in here.
 
Little Nightmares VR: Altered Echoes releases April 24, 2026, on PlayStation VR2, Meta Quest, and Steam VR.
